import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.manifold import TSNE
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

# Generate a labeled dataset for visualization
X, y = make_classification(n_samples=200, n_features=10, n_classes=3, random_state=42)

# Apply t-SNE to reduce to 2 dimensions
tsne = TSNE(n_components=2, random_state=42)
X_tsne = tsne.fit_transform(X)

# Create a dataframe with t-SNE components and labels
df_tsne = pd.DataFrame({
    'tsne_x': X_tsne[:, 0],
    'tsne_y': X_tsne[:, 1],
    'label': y
})

# Print the shape and first few rows
print(f"t-SNE result shape: {df_tsne.shape}")
print("\nt-SNE Embedding (first 10 rows):")
print(df_tsne.head(10))
print("\nClass distribution in embedding:")
print(df_tsne['label'].value_counts().sort_index())
